field_principles.field_principles: Each required field states why the evidence is present.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Unsafe or changed inputs stop scoring before any tuple decision.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The exact value states that this reducer runs no model inference.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time proves that a fresh reducer process ran.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Exact hashes bind every decision to immutable source artifacts.
field_principles.rows: One terminal row per cell prevents failures from disappearing in aggregates.
field_principles.source_offset_rows: Byte-offset receipts expose UTF-8 drift and invalid boundaries.
field_principles.source_byte_identity_rows: Quoted bytes must equal the exact saved source bytes.
field_principles.parser_rows: Parser failures and bypass attempts remain terminal evidence.
field_principles.tuple_type_rows: Arity and field types block malformed tuples from later scoring.
field_principles.entity_anchor_rows: Closed entity membership rejects partial or invented entities.
field_principles.relation_direction_rows: Subject and object roles must match the visible source relation.
field_principles.omission_rows: Required visible relations cannot disappear from coverage claims.
field_principles.duplicate_rows: Repeated tuples receive no extra credit and remain visible.
field_principles.abstention_rows: False abstentions stay separate from parser and tuple failures.
field_principles.arm_summary_rows: Arm denominators prevent controls from filling model cells.
field_principles.model_summary_rows: Model summaries expose each producer without cross-model pooling.
field_principles.family_summary_rows: Family summaries expose weak source structures.
field_principles.seed_summary_rows: Seed summaries expose stochastic failures and deterministic controls.
field_principles.wilson_interval_rows: Intervals show uncertainty with exact row denominators.
field_principles.proposal_coverage_by_arm: Coverage measures syntactic proposals without calling them correct.
field_principles.source_grounded_correctness_by_arm: Correctness requires a complete exact source-grounded tuple set.
field_principles.held_sidecar_access_count: Zero proves that formal ASP labels stayed sealed.
field_principles.model_inference_call_count: Zero proves that saved proposals were not regenerated.
field_principles.reported_vs_recomputed_metrics: Fresh row replay detects stale or changed aggregates.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed identifier makes the deterministic reducer contract explicit.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable digest detects decision drift across fresh processes.
field_principles.source_tuple_shard_ready_score: Readiness means complete evidence, not universal correctness.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Each failed gate records its expected and observed values.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True states that exact source bytes define this bounded decision.
field_principles.verdict_class: The closed class prevents an oracle-backed result from claiming positive.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A complete prefix marks a terminal result for the conductor.
field_principles.gate:preconditions_passed: This exact expected-versus-observed gate prevents incomplete evidence from passing.
